topFactors.label: Loan repayment history
topFactors.message: You have no loan history yet, so there is no repayment record to rely on. New borrowers start lower.

topFactors.label: Employment
topFactors.message: Less predictable income makes repayments harder to plan.
topFactors.improve: Your income is informal or gig work. Bank statements or platform payouts showing regular monthly deposits make it count as steadier.

topFactors.label: Essentials against income
topFactors.message: Your essentials, adjusted for local inflation, take up most of your income.
topFactors.improve: Essentials take 83% of income (₹16,644 of ₹20,000). Cutting about ₹4,644 a month, or showing that much more regular income, brings them to 60%.
